items.title: Candido Camero — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: fortunate enough to work and also recorded with Count Basie when I came here to the United States, with Count Basie, with Stan Kenton, Duke Ellington with Tommy Dorsey, with Woody Herman, with Buddy Rich

ctx.x: All of them. They all had their different style and arrangements, and musicians. I was

fortunate enough to work and also recorded with Count Basie when I came here to the United States, with Count Basie, with Stan Kenton, Duke Ellington with Tommy Dorsey, with Woody Herman, with Buddy Rich - those were the bands that were heard there in Cuba.
During that same period of which we are speaking, which Cuban musicians played jazz in Cuba?
